src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Each patterned region has a row whose foreground run reaches the right edge;
    # mark the trailing empty extension in the corresponding boundary row.
    bg=max(set(sum(g,[])), key=sum(g[i][j]==sum(g,[])[0] for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])))) if False else 0
    # background is most common color
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # choose patterned row with a foreground prefix and empty suffix; among rows prefer maximal suffix
    candidates=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        nz=[j for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg]
        if nz and nz[-1]<len(r)-1:
            candidates.append((len(r)-1-nz[-1],i,nz[-1]))
    if candidates:
        _,i,j=max(candidates)
        for c in range(j+1,len(g[0])): g[i][c]=1
    return g
'''
